chapter: National Guard band and first jobs in Chicago
title: Leaving the Tavern band for Bernie Young; Dolly Jones as leader
summary: Bernie Young organised his own recording band and Caldwell left the Tavern, whose band belonged to trumpeter Dolly Jones.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: And then Bernie Young played trumpet himself.
Bernie, he organized, he took us out of that group and organized his own band for recording and playing. I left then.. I left that group at the Tavern and joined Bernie Young.
Wait a minute. What am I saying here? Well, whose was the band at the Tavern?
That blew it (unintelligible), the band actually belonged to -- the name was Dyer, they called him, real name was Dyer, Dolly's mother, Dyer Jones.
That's right, was Dyer Jones -- her name was Dolly Jones. She had the group.
